 The Rajasthan Board of Secondary Education (RBSE) had earlier announced the start date and timings for RBSE Class 10 and 12 theory exams 2027. RBSE was planning to conduct the Rajasthan Board 10th and 12th theory exams from February 16. But in a recent update, RBSE has decided to change the earlier announced dates due to Census 2027.
 Students will be able to download the RBSE Class 10 and 12 subject-wise date sheet 2027 soon from the official website at rajeduboard.rajasthan.gov.in.
 Manipur Board has also announced the COHSEM Class 12 board exam dates 2027. Manipur Class 12 board 2027 theory exams will be held from February 11 to March 19, while practicals will be conducted from January 2 to 30. 
 The Council for the Indian School Certificate Examinations (CISCE) will conduct ISCE exams 2027 from February 15 to March 31 , while ISC papers will run from February 9 to April 8. The school education boards of Bihar, Assam, Gujarat, Tamil Nadu, Uttarakhand, Telangana and other states have yet to publish the timetable for the Class 10th and 12th board exams in 2027.
